_readme: Small config the agent reads/writes each run. artifactUrl is filled in after the first successful publish and must be reused (not regenerated) on every subsequent run so updates land on the same page instead of creating a new one each day.
pagesPublishScope: every run — uses GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN if set (scheduled cloud runs), else the local gh CLI
lastRunStatus: Weekly research run: 3 new evidence rows admitted (MIT CISR four-archetype IT operating-model study, McKinsey help-desk case study, PwC 2026 Global AI Jobs Barometer). One new opportunity created: help-desk-tiered-support-flattens-agentic-automation (score 3), partially closing the Help Desk/IT Support coverage gap. One red-team score downgrade: ai-talent-strategy-gap-retention-risk 4→3, now contested (EY's own UK survey data shows heavy AI-training investment correlates with 59% higher attrition, complicating the retention thesis). Red-teamed 7 opportunities at evidenceScore>=4 not covered on 2026-08-10; six had no contradicting evidence survive. Corrected two pre-existing breadthBasis under-counts and rewrote five summaries (three pre-existing, two touched this run) that had drifted over the 4-paragraph cap. Product Management and QA/Test Engineering searched again; only commentary/framework pieces without disclosed methodology found, nothing admitted. Both the Claude Artifact and the GitHub Pages mirror published successfully (publish_pages.py and --verify both exited 0).
pagesTokenPermissions: fine-grained PAT, repository access limited to sdm1130/ai-it-research-tracker, Contents: Read and write (Metadata: Read-only is added automatically). Nothing else required: main has no branch protection or rulesets, and Pages is build_type=legacy on main:/ so it rebuilds on push.

pagesPublishExitCodes.3: no credentials — skip and report mirror stale
pagesPublishExitCodes.1: real failure e.g. expired token — report loudly
